items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This consisted of Harvey Phillips on tuba, Hunt Butler on tenor saxophone, Kurt Bahn on bass, Jim Beard on piano, and . . .

ctx.x: And mostly in Indianapolis? Or did you play all around the area?

No, no. Mostly in Indianapolis. Gradually there developed a group of students that I could work with down here. I didn’t make any concerted effort to have anything other than the band that was the school band, because there were not that many jobs to be worked down here. But I did put together a group, finally, first as a bass player, because I worked a lot as a bass player – I had a group – and then ultimately with cello as the focal point. I’m absolutely drawing a blank for any of the people that I worked with.…
